values.binNote: Not-in-a-dummy-fight utility (minion/monster-only stun) with no corresponding data value in the sheet's SionE rows; the sheet has no minion-stun-duration field to name.

mechanics.claim: Deals magic damage to only the first enemy champion hit by the shockwave.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: If the target is a minion or non-epic monster it is knocked back and can apply the ability's effects again to enemies it passes through, creating additional damage instances.
mechanics.quote: applying ''Roar of the Slayer's'' effects to enemies they pass through as well as briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around their trajectory

mechanics.claim: Displaced minions/monsters take their damage only once stopped, if it would kill them.
mechanics.quote: take their damage once they are stopped if they would die to ''Roar of the Slayer's'' damage

mechanics.claim: Changing AP or the ability's rank while its projectile is traveling changes the damage of every future hit from that cast, including the minion-projectile.
mechanics.quote: Gaining or losing {{as|AP}}, or upgrading the ability while its projectile is traveling will change its damage for every future hit.

mechanics.claim: Can be blocked by spell shields.
